description: Source code for MainActivity of the Advanced AI Calculator Android app. Implements UI setup, theme toggling, calculation input (including calculator buttons), voice recognition, and simple expression evaluation with placeholder logic for backend integration.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling UI interactions, voice input, theme toggling, and basic expression evaluation.

classes.name: HistoryItem
classes.description: Data class representing a calculation history entry with user input, result, and explanation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI elements, themes, and listeners.

methods.name: setupCalculatorButtonListeners
methods.description: Configures button click handlers for calculator digit and operator buttons, and clear/reset.

methods.name: insertTextAtCursor
methods.description: Helper function for inserting symbols/characters into input field at cursor position.

methods.name: setupTheme
methods.description: Applies color schemes based on light or dark mode.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Attaches event handlers for UI controls such as submit, voice, theme toggle, and history toggle.

methods.name: setupHistoryList
methods.description: Initializes and populates the calculation history listview.

methods.name: fillFromHistory
methods.description: Populates input field with a selected history item.

methods.name: toggleHistoryPanel
methods.description: Shows or hides the calculation history panel.

methods.name: processUserQuery
methods.description: Handles user input/query, performs evaluation, and updates display and history.

methods.name: addToHistory
methods.description: Adds a new calculation to the history list and refreshes display.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Provides basic, demo evaluation of expressions; placeholder for backend call.

methods.name: startVoiceInput
methods.description: Starts voice recognition after permission check, and handles recognition results.

methods.name: openSettingsScreen
methods.description: Stub for launching settings screen; currently shows toast message.
